capabilities.title: Self-hosted newsletter and campaign platform: subscriber management, campaign send, analytics
capabilities.sourceEvidence: Listmonk: high-performance self-hosted newsletter server in Go
capabilities.reason: Nexus is an intelligence dashboard, not a newsletter platform. Listmonk's core product is outside scope.

capabilities.title: Campaign template engine: variable substitution, HTML templates with preview
capabilities.sourceEvidence: Listmonk template engine: Go templates with subscriber variable injection

capabilities.title: High-performance single-binary Go server with embedded PostgreSQL migrations
capabilities.sourceEvidence: Listmonk: single binary, built-in migration runner, ~10MB binary
capabilities.reason: Nexus ships a Next.js standalone runtime inside Tauri; adding a separate Go/PostgreSQL service would duplicate the runtime and storage architecture without a current need.
